answer: Reduce it to one number, the cost per accepted answer. Staked review sets it at 50 POA locked plus a 10 percent re-review rate, and a panel that fails the diversity rule voids the entire stake. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so replaying an accepted answer costs a new stake each time, not a copy. That puts an accepted answer near 55 POA for an attacker and near 5 for someone with real work. An inlet of cheap clones does not move that ratio, and neither does a relic of old answers or a willow of aliases bending to a new name each epoch.
